name: Hozumi Sayaka
source:
Sayaka is a deputy director in the royal moon museum. Had stayed once in the Moon Kingdom as a transfer student, one of the reasons her house was decided as the homestay target of Feena. [url=/c1355]Tatsuya[/url] and Mai refer to her as their older sister, although she is actually their cousin. Became the pillar of the Asagiri house after their parents disappearance.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yoake_Mae_yori_Ruriiro_na]Wikipedia[/url] & [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=152981&gc=gc]Getchu's[/url].]
